'''CI-004 Research Facility''' was a scientific complex used by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] on [[Dxun/Legends|Dxun]]. Around [[3627 BBY]]<ref name="TOR Dates Forums">{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?p=9852711#edit9852711|text=Charles Boyd on Forums: "Dear Story Team, What Year Are We Currently In?" (1)}}</ref>, an assault team was [[CI-004 Incident|employed]] to handle an outbreak in the facility.<ref name="TOR" />
